description: This file defines a BitBake recipe for building and installing Xen hypervisor tools and utilities, including dependencies, packages, systemd and init scripts, and deployment steps.

classes.name: dependency_requirements
classes.description: Specifies RDEPENDS, RRECOMMENDS, RSUGGESTS for various packages.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment, calls common configuration.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the tools using make, handling Python environment.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built tools and cleans up certain files, sets up volatile directories, and configures systemd or init scripts.

methods.name: pkg_postinst:${PN}-volatiles
methods.description: Post-installation step to create volatile directories using systemd or init.d.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Deploys Xen policy files to deployment directory.
